jobs.title: Research Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Research Program Manager \- Genetics \& Biospecimen Operations manages the UCSF Memory and Aging Center's Genetics and Biospecimen Program, achieving the majority of program objectives through the coordinated work of direct\-report administrative, data\-management, laboratory supervisory, research associate, and laboratory assistant staff. The role sets priorities, staffing plans, operating standards, and quality expectations for biospecimen collection and sample processing performed by subordinate staff, while overseeing outsourced biobanking, specimen distribution, access/governance, genetic and biomarker data\-sharing workflows, and operational support for clinical and observational studies.  

The role functions primarily through staff and external partners rather than hands\-on laboratory processing. It supervises the MAC Sample Processing Laboratory, oversees outsourced biobanking relationships and service delivery, and serves as a liaison to study PIs and research teams for collection protocols, processing workflows, sample access, distribution, and biospecimen\-, biomarker\-, and genetic\-data requirements.  

The Research Program Manager \- Genetics \& Biospecimen Operations reports directly to Dr. Adam Boxer and serves as the central operational authority for the MAC Genetics and Biospecimen Program. The role manages the MAC Sample Processing Laboratory through subordinate staff and oversees outsourced biobanking infrastructure and partnerships supporting four major MAC observational research programs and biomarker cores: ADRC, PPG, BrANCH, and ALLFTD. The position also provides operational support for Boxer Lab\-specific biomarker discovery projects and related needs across MAC faculty, postdocs, and fellows.


The position operates with a high degree of autonomy, translating PI, study, and core objectives into subordinate goals, staffing and workload plans, collection and processing protocols, SOPs, governance processes, documentation systems, quality controls, and sustainable service models. The incumbent achieves the majority of operational objectives through direct reports and coordinates across principal investigators, clinicians, physicians, research coordinators, data teams, finance analysts, UCSF administrative partners, NIH program officials, external researchers, vendors, ATRI, NCRAD, and the 25\+ ALLFTD participating sites.


For ALLFTD, the incumbent serves as the external\-facing operational representative for biospecimen banking and distribution, including oversight of outsourced biobanking services and liaison with NCRAD regarding specimen distribution, sample availability, genetic data sharing, and biospecimen\-associated information. The role supports communication with PIs, clinicians, physicians, and site teams and ensures distribution and data\-sharing activities align with study governance, participant consent, institutional requirements, MTAs/DTAs, applicable policies, and vendor/service expectations.


For ADRC, PPG, and BrANCH, the incumbent provides Biomarker Core operational consultation to investigators, including collection protocol development, sample\-processing feasibility, outsourced biobanking strategy, sample/data linkage, secure workflows, and implementation planning for MAC and non\-MAC projects. The incumbent represents the UCSF ADRC on national best\-practices biomarker working groups in collaboration with NACC, maintains external biobanking and service partnerships including ATRI, and works with finance analysts and leadership on recharge, cost\-recovery, vendor/contract oversight, and sustainability strategies for a team with salary costs exceeding $1M annually.


The position is accountable for managing a defined, multi\-study observational research infrastructure program through subordinate staff and external service partners. Effective leadership in this role is critical to compliant biospecimen collection, reliable sample processing, outsourced banking and distribution, secure and transparent data\-sharing workflows, investigator service delivery, financial sustainability, vendor accountability, and operational continuity across the MAC's major observational research programs.  



**Department Overview**

The UCSF Edward and Pearl Fein Memory and Aging Center (MAC) is an internationally renowned clinical research center with over 200 full time employees with offices and clinical research space located in the Sandler Neurosciences Building and multiple other buildings on the UCSF Mission Bay Campus. The MAC provides clinical care for patients suffering from neurodegenerative disease processes; from this clinical population, external referrals, and direct recruitment efforts we enroll patients into more than 50 structured research protocols and/or treatment trials.


The Boxer Lab at the MAC has a mission to find effective, scientifically based treatments that lead to a cure for neurodegenerative brain diseases. This is accomplished through clinical trials that emphasize patient and family benefits and public health impact, and observational studies that deepen our understanding of the biological mechanisms of neurodegenerative disease.


  
**Required Qualifications**

• Master's degree in related area and minimum six years of related experience or equivalent experience / training.


• Experience managing biospecimen operations for human\-subjects research, including collection requirements, sample processing workflows, inventory and banking, retrieval, distribution, and linkage of specimens with associated clinical, biomarker, or genetic data.


• Experience supporting complex observational, biomarker, genetics, and/or multisite research programs, including translating study requirements into collection protocols, SOPs, operational workflows, staffing plans, and implementation procedures.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview

ER Restoration is seeking an experienced, organized, and highly motivated

**Operations Manager** to oversee the day\-to\-day operations of our water damage, fire damage, mitigation, and reconstruction projects.

The Operations Manager will be responsible for keeping projects moving efficiently from initial loss through final completion, while coordinating field crews, subcontractors, project managers, vendors, and office staff.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, solves problems before they become bigger problems, holds people accountable, and understands the urgency and customer service required in the insurance restoration industry.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee daily operations for mitigation and reconstruction projects.
* Coordinate and manage project schedules, field technicians, subcontractors, vendors, and project managers.
* Ensure jobs progress according to schedule, scope of work, budget, and company standards.
* Conduct regular job reviews and identify delays, outstanding items, and potential problems.
* Maintain clear communication between the office, field personnel, customers, adjusters, property managers, and other parties involved in each project.
* Help coordinate emergency water and fire damage response.
* Monitor labor, materials, equipment, subcontractor costs, and overall job profitability.
* Review project documentation and ensure files are complete and properly maintained.
* Ensure technicians and subcontractors follow company procedures, safety requirements, and quality standards.
* Coordinate material ordering, equipment, inspections, subcontractors, and scheduling.
* Assist with hiring, training, supervising, and evaluating field personnel.
* Hold employees and subcontractors accountable for schedules, workmanship, documentation, and customer service.
* Conduct production meetings and maintain accurate project status reports.
* Help resolve customer concerns and project\-related issues quickly and professionally.
* Work closely with ownership to improve operational systems, productivity, profitability, and company growth.

Qualifications

* 3\+ years of experience in construction, restoration, property damage, or a related industry preferred.
* Previous operations, project management, production management, or construction management experience strongly preferred.
* Experience with **water/fire damage restoration and insurance claims** is a major plus.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing and project scheduling.
* Ability to manage multiple active projects simultaneously.
* Strong leadership and personnel\-management skills.
* Excellent organization, communication, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Comfortable holding employees and subcontractors accountable.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
* Strong computer and technology skills.
* Experience with **Xactimate** and restoration/construction project\-management software is preferred.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

What We're Looking For

The right person for this position is someone who:

* **Takes ownership** instead of waiting to be told what to do.
* Understands that **communication and follow\-through are critical** in restoration.
* Can manage people while maintaining high expectations.
* Knows how to prioritize multiple jobs and emergencies.
* Pays attention to details without losing sight of the overall project.
* Understands the importance of job profitability and controlling costs.
* Can identify problems early and develop solutions.
* Treats customers, employees, subcontractors, and insurance professionals professionally.
* Wants to help build better systems and grow with the company.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by:

* Projects completed on schedule.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Quality of workmanship.
* Proper job documentation.
* Effective crew and subcontractor scheduling.
* Reduced project delays.
* Labor and material cost control.
* Project profitability.
* Communication and accountability throughout the company.

Compensation

**Competitive salary based on experience.**

Additional compensation opportunities, benefits, vehicle allowance/company vehicle, phone allowance, PTO, and performance incentives may be offered depending on experience and qualifications.

Schedule

Full\-time position. Because ER Restoration handles emergency property damage, occasional after\-hours availability may be required.

Join ER Restoration

This is an opportunity for an experienced operations professional to take an important leadership role within a growing restoration company. We are looking for someone who can bring organization, accountability, leadership, and consistency to our operations while helping us deliver excellent service to our customers.

Pay: From $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr HR Coordinator
jobs.description:
Reports to: Human Resources Manager


Start Date: Open until filled


Work Schedule: 9:00 am\-5:00 pm M\-F, or as dictated by operational needs


Location: Novato, CA


Organizational Overview


Homeward Bound is Marin County’s primary provider of housing and shelter for single individuals and families experiencing homelessness, offering short\- and long\-term supportive housing, job training and placement, and services. Our mission is “Opening Doors to Safety, Dignity, Home and Independence.” We are looking for the right person to join our team.

  

Imagine being part of a company where effort creates hope and opportunity. For 50 plus years, Homeward Bound of Marin has helped individuals and families experiencing homelessness find their path to housing and stability with the goal of ending homelessness in Marin County.

  

Position Summary


The Senior Human Resources Coordinator provides day\-to\-day administrative support for Homeward Bound's Human Resources function and helps ensure employee processes, records, and requests are handled accurately and timely. Reporting to the Human Resources Manager, this position serves as an accessible first point of contact for employees and supports employee records, employment documentation, onboarding, recruitment, routine benefit questions, and department organization.


The Coordinator also supports the Human Resources Manager with trainings, investigations, meetings, and other departmental priorities. The position will support select organization\-wide operational and accessibility functions and may work directly with the Chief Operating Officer, Property Manager, or other department leaders on assigned matters. This role is a great fit for someone who is organized, responsive, and committed to a mission\-driven organization.

  

Key Responsibilities


Human Resource

* Employee Support: Serve as a first point of contact for routine employee HR questions and requests, escalating complex matters to the Human Resources Manager.
* HR Administration: Prepare offer letters, employment changes, separation letters, and other routine HR correspondence using approved templates and processes.
* Data Management: Maintain accurate and confidential personnel files and keep employee information current in ADP Workforce Now.
* Onboarding and Recruitment: Coordinate onboarding, background checks, job postings, interview scheduling, candidate communication, and related recruitment logistics.
* Benefits and Follow\-Up: Assist with routine benefit enrollment and access questions, track outstanding documentation and HR deadlines, and coordinate follow\-up as appropriate.
* HR Manager Support: In partnership with and under the direction of the Human Resources Manager, assist with investigations, employee meetings, performance documentation, trainings, employee engagement, and other priorities.

  

Operations

* Provide administrative and project support to the Chief Operating Officer and designated department leaders on assigned operational matters.
* Research and follow up on assigned vendor, billing, service, or documentation issues through resolution or escalation.
* Support cross\-functional projects requiring administrative coordination and follow\-through, including work with the Property Manager as assigned.

  

Accessibility Coordination

* Coordinate the intake, documentation, tracking, and follow\-up of disability\-related accommodation and accessibility requests.
* Work with the Human Resources Manager on employee accommodations and with program or property leadership on participant or facility requests.
* Serve as Homeward Bound's designated Section 504 Coordinator, maintain required records and notices, and escalate complex matters as appropriate.


Qualifications

* 2\+ years of experience in Human Resources, HR coordination, or a related administrative role
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
* Basic working knowledge of California and federal employment laws and HR best practices
* Experience with HR software (ADP Workforce Now preferred), Microsoft Office, and applicant tracking systems
* Strong communication, organization, attention to detail, and follow\-through
* Experience supporting a nonprofit, social services, housing, culinary, hospitality, or similarly diverse workforce is a plus
* Experience supporting disability accommodation, accessibility, or cross\-functional administrative processes is a plus


\-


Impact of the Role


The Senior Human Resources Coordinator helps keep Homeward Bound's HR processes organized, responsive, and accessible to employees. Through accurate records, timely follow\-through, and support across HR and select organization\-wide functions, this role contributes to a respectful and well\-organized workplace.

  

Equal Opportunity Employer

  

Homeward Bound is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, and training. It has always been and continues to be Homeward Bound’s policy that employees should be able to enjoy a work environment free from all forms of harassment and discrimination. We encourage applicants of diverse backgrounds to apply for any open position for which they feel qualified.


There is no relocation available for this role.


To apply Send resume and cover letter to: careers@hbofm.org with the position in the subject.

Just ask any of our over 20,000 associates who work at Five Below and they’ll tell you there’s no other place like it. It all starts with our purpose and then, The Five Below Way, which is our values and behaviors that each and every associate believes in.


It’s all about culture at Five Below, making this a place that can inspire you as much as you inspire us with big ideas, super energy, passion, and the ability to make the workplace a WOWplace!

* Helps oversee the daily activities of all store associates, ensuring they are performing their duties effectively and providing excellent customer service.
* Assists with the receiving, unpacking, and organizing of new stock to ensure items are quickly and efficiently placed on the sales floor
* Acts as Manager on Duty when needed, taking full responsibility for store operations, staff management, customer service, and addressing any urgent issues.

* Supports the onboarding and ongoing training of associates, helping them learn store policies, product knowledge, and operational procedures to improve their performance.

jobs.title: Enforcement Operations Lead, Cloud Partners
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
------------------



Anthropic's Safeguards team is responsible for enforcing our policies, protecting users, and ensuring our platform is not misused. A large and growing share of Claude usage reaches customers through our cloud partners: Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. As the Enforcement Operations Lead for Multi\-Cloud, you'll own how Anthropic detects, reviews, and acts on misuse across those surfaces, where the partner owns the customer relationship and often the data path. You'll build the operating model, partner agreements, and documentation that make enforcement on every cloud consistent, auditable, and fast.



This role requires someone who is detail\-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of coordinating across teams and companies to break new ground and drive work to completion. This work is deeply cross\-functional. You'll partner closely with our product managers, policy experts, Safeguards engineering, Legal, and the trust \& safety and operations teams across our Cloud partners to maintain a consistent and safe enforcement ecosystem.


*Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.*


**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the end to end enforcement lifecycle on partner surfaces, from detection and review through action, customer communication, and appeal
* Define enforcement paths for each partner's operating model, including how actions are requested, executed, and confirmed when the partner controls the account
* Manage SLAs for review, escalation, and action, and evaluate performance against them on an ongoing basis
* Develop and maintain SOPs and escalation guides for all enforcement workflows, ensuring consistency across clouds
* Establish red\-teaming, Quality processes, and operationalize shared metrics
* Stand up paired investigations with partner threat intelligence teams, including case referrals, indicator sharing, and paging for high severity incidents
* Own enforcement metrics across partner surfaces and report them to Safeguards leadership, partners, and regulators

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------


* Extensive experience in trust and safety operations, enforcement, threat intelligence, or a related field
* Have managed external partner or vendor relationships where you did not control the other side's systems or priorities
* Comfortable working across policy, legal, engineering, and operations teams to translate requirements into practical workflows
* Experience building enforcement programs from the ground up, including SLAs, escalation paths, and quality measurement
* Highly organized, with a track record of maintaining rigorous documentation and SOPs in fast\-moving environments
* Clear and precise communication, both in writing and verbally, across technical and non\-technical audiences, including partner executives
* Energized by the challenge of building scalable systems in an environment where not everything is already figured out
* Care deeply about the responsible deployment of AI and the role enforcement operations plays in that mission

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------


* Direct trust \& safety, abuse, or security operations experience at AWS, GCP, or Azure, or at a company that ships through their marketplaces
* Experience designing incident response or escalation processes that span more than one company
* Familiarity with data access controls, audit requirements, or privacy constrained review environments
* Experience with law enforcement referrals, regulatory reporting, or compliance programs
* Background in AI safety, content moderation, fraud, or abuse detection systems
* Comfort working with data and metrics to inform operational decisions and surface trends to leadership
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.



For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.


Annual Salary:


$285,000 \- $330,000 USD

-------------


**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience


**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience


**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position


**Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.


**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Sales (AGS) team interacts with leading companies and believes that world\-class support is critical to customer success.  

  

The NAMER Global Sales Strategy \& Operations team is seeking a driven, experienced, and strategically minded Sales Operations Lead for the US Specialist organization. Area Specialists engage directly with assigned customers in partnership with Field Sales teams to provide subject matter expertise critical to advancing and launching opportunities. Area Specialists are part of the Account Teams for account planning, opportunity identification and pursuit (including RFP/RFIs, architecture development), closing deals, and shepherding wins to post\-sales teams. Acting as the front\-line touch point for Specialist customer engagement, Area Specialists provide data and anecdotes on what is working and what is not back into Worldwide and Service teams.  

  

The FSO Lead for the US Specialist Org will serve as the strategic operations owner and COO\-equivalent for the Specialist organization, functioning as a critical business partner to sales leadership. This is a forward\-looking, tech\-enabled operations leadership position — one that goes beyond traditional quota management and represents a strategic investment in operational leadership, ensuring the organization executes with rigor, scales effectively, and maximizes revenue potential across its domains. The ideal candidate will drive cross\-divisional operational excellence, leverage AI\-powered tools and automation to accelerate business cadences and surface insights faster, serve as the critical conduit between field and worldwide teams to ensure alignment and execution consistency, and enable sales leaders to focus on customer engagement and revenue generation.  

  

This candidate will own the rhythm of the business, including Annual Planning Cycles, Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews, and other cadenced reporting and metrics. They will drive pipeline growth strategies, inspect and resolve stalled opportunities, and establish standardized reporting and insights that enable data\-driven decision\-making at scale. This role will also lead the strategic definition of key sales support systems and processes — including the identification and adoption of GenAI capabilities — to meet the growth trajectory of the business and achieve revenue and market development objectives. The ideal candidate brings strong business and financial acumen, broad technical skills, sales and marketing expertise, a deep analytic background, and a genuine curiosity about how emerging AI tools can transform the way operations teams work.  

  

This position works with multiple stakeholders supporting the extended Enterprise Sales organization, including Business Development, Marketing, Professional Services, and the Partner team. The candidate must communicate effectively across technical and non\-technical business units and across geographies as necessary.  

The candidate will play a key role in defining processes for end\-to\-end execution of territory planning and account alignment, sales compensation management, headcount planning, and revenue and goals planning. A successful candidate demonstrates a proven work ethic that drives results, is willing to "roll up their sleeves" in a hands\-on, matrixed environment, and actively embraces AI and automation as tools to work smarter and move faster.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as strategic business partner and COO\-equivalent to sales leadership, driving operational rigor and enabling leaders to focus on customer engagement and revenue generation
* Define and execute go\-to\-market strategy in partnership with sales leadership, ensuring cross\-divisional alignment and execution consistency
* Own end\-to\-end business cadences including Annual Planning, MBRs, QBRs, territory design, quota setting, and headcount management
* Drive pipeline inspection and growth strategies, identifying and resolving stalled opportunities to maximize revenue potential

jobs.title: Program Manager (Ops)
jobs.description:
**About Pearl**

  

Founded in 2013, Pearl is a ratings and standards company building the national standard for home performance. Pearl SCORE™ rates every single\-family home in the U.S. across five key pillars — Safety, Comfort, Operations, Resilience, and Energy — so homebuyers, homeowners, and real estate professionals can understand how a home performs in daily life.

  

Today, the value of a home is judged by its location, size, and aesthetics— but these factors overlook the home’s most important function: safeguarding the comfort, well\-being, and finances of the people inside. Most American homes underperform in these regards because home performance is simply not on our radar. We can’t see it, quantify it, or put a value on it. Pearl aims to change that by making home performance a central part of how we view and value our homes.

  

We are not a home inspector, a contractor, a real estate platform, or a green\-certification program — we rate homes against a transparent, evidence\-based standard so that home performance becomes visible, measurable, and valuable in the real estate market.

  

As a Certified B Corporation, we're accountable not only to our shareholders, but also to the homeowners and communities we serve. For more information, visit pearlscore.com.

 **About the role**


This is a hands\-on program management role. The program manager will work closely with the people doing the work: building project plans alongside engineering managers, product managers, marketers, BD, customer success, and operations staff; breaking programs and projects down to the task level; and keeping multiple concurrent projects moving from initiation to close.


You'll own the day\-to\-day execution machinery of our program portfolio. You'll translate strategic priorities and committed requirements into detailed, realistic project plans, then actively manage those plans. You’ll surface risks early, chase down blockers, adjust sequencing when reality intervenes, and keep stakeholders informed.

 **What you'll do**

* Develop and maintain detailed project plans for multiple concurrent projects and programs, working directly with the individual contributors and team leads doing the work
* Facilitate planning sessions with cross\-functional teams to break initiatives into tasks, estimates, dependencies, and owners
* Run day\-to\-day project execution: standups or check\-ins, status tracking, risk and issue logs, and action\-item follow\-through
* Administrate communication and project plans via Pearl’s instance of Notion.
* Identify blockers early and drive them to resolution, escalating what requires leadership attention with recommendations attached
* Keep project documentation, trackers, and status reporting accurate, current, and useful to both teams and leadership (AI usage is encouraged at Pearl, with accuracy always in mind)
* Coordinate handoffs and dependencies across departments, catching gaps before they become slips
* In partnership with the Product team and VP of Operations, build lightweight, repeatable project management practices that fit the goals of the company.
* Support program\-level rollups so leadership has a reliable, at\-a\-glance view of portfolio health

 **What we are looking for**

* 4–7 years of project or program management experience, with demonstrated ownership of multiple concurrent cross\-functional projects
* Experience at a startup or small company where you worked directly with delivery teams
* Strong command of core PM fundamentals: work breakdown, dependency mapping, estimation, risk management, and status communication
* Excellent facilitation skills: Able to run a planning session with a room of busy people and leave with documented commitments
* High follow\-through and attention to detail; you close loops without being reminded
* Comfort with ambiguity: you can start planning from a rough goal and iteratively sharpen it with the team
* Clear, concise written communication \- in a remote\-first environment, documentation and written communication are crucial
* Proficiency with Notion, AI tools, and automation capabilities for program management

**Nice to have**

* PMP, CAPM, or agile certification (or equivalent practical depth)
* Experience in home performance, energy efficiency, climate tech, SaaS, or data products
* Experience introducing or maturing PM practices

 **Why work at Pearl?**

* We are a **mission\-driven** company: we love what we do and the impact we are making.
* **Impact.** Everything you do here will matter. Your opinion and contributions will make a big difference to the future of this company and our mission of making home performance *matter*.
* **Flexibility.** We are 100% remote \- work where you feel comfortable.
* **Environment.** We value candor, excellence, and collaboration while fostering creativity and camaraderie. We are supportive and genuinely enjoy celebrating each others’ wins!
* **Ownership.** You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy in a fast\-paced, evolving startup world.
* ***Equality between people.*** We support diversity, championing our differences, and most importantly, *learn* from one another. Pearl is an equal opportunity employer, and candidates from all backgrounds and life experiences are encouraged to apply.

 **Compensation and Benefits:**

* Market salary based on experience and local conditions, in the range of $120k to $140k
* Medical, vision and dental coverage provided at **no cost** for employees *and their families*(with an option to purchase upgraded coverage at a minimal cost to employee)
* FSA, HSA, and dependent care accounts
* Life insurance coverage
* Employer paid cell phone service
* 401(k) with employer match up to 4%
* Stock options
* 15 vacation days during the calendar year, plus holidays (including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day), a floating holiday for your birthday, sick days, and paid parental leave
* Flexible work environment: work remote

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Spinwheel**
-------------------


Spinwheel is the agentic API platform for real\-time consumer credit data and payments.


With just a phone number and date of birth, financial innovators can instantly access complete consumer credit data, attributes, and payments through a single, beautifully simple API. We serve banks, lenders, fintechs, credit unions, and other financial services companies that need to verify identity, understand consumer debt, and execute payments at scale.


Our platform brings together Connect for identity and account authentication, Profile for real\-time debt intelligence across all three bureaus, and Pay for payments and balance transfers, creating a unified infrastructure layer for some of the most important financial experiences consumers have.


We’re a growth\-stage company with a lean, ambitious team, sophisticated customers, and a big market opportunity ahead of us.  

  

This is a **fully\-remote role** that can be based anywhere in the US or Canada, West\-Coast preferred.

**The Role**
------------


We’re looking for an **Enterprise Customer Success Manager** to own and grow relationships with some of Spinwheel’s most strategic customers.


You’ll be deeply involved with your customers’ businesses, helping them get more value from Spinwheel, anticipating risks before they become problems, and identifying opportunities to expand the relationship.


You’ll build relationships from the executive level to the teams working with our platform every day. You’ll understand what your customers are trying to accomplish, translate that into a strategy for success with Spinwheel, and mobilize the right people internally to make it happen.

Most importantly, you’ll become someone our customers trust to help move their business forward.

------------------

* **Become a trusted advisor** to executive, operational, and technical stakeholders by deeply understanding their businesses, priorities, and goals.
* **Build and execute customer success plans** that connect product adoption to measurable business and revenue outcomes.

* **Lead complex customer issues through resolution**, partnering with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Compliance to diagnose problems, establish ownership, and keep customers informed.
* **Bring the voice of the customer into Spinwheel**, turning what you hear into actionable insights that influence our product roadmap and GTM strategy.
* **Help us scale Customer Success**, improving how we onboard, engage, support, and grow enterprise customers as Spinwheel grows.
* **Create customer advocates**, identifying opportunities for references, case studies, testimonials, and other ways to showcase customer success.

**What You Bring**
------------------


You’re a strategic relationship builder who knows that great enterprise Customer Success requires equal parts commercial instinct, customer empathy, operational rigor, and problem solving.


You’ll bring

* 7–10\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic Accounts, or a similar client\-facing role within SaaS, fintech, or another high\-growth technology company.
* Experience managing a book of \~50\+ customers representing $2M\+ revenue
* A strong track record managing complex, high\-value enterprise relationships.
* Experience building credibility and trusted relationships with senior executives.
* The ability to understand a customer’s business objectives and connect them to product adoption, retention, and expansion.
* Strong commercial instincts and comfort identifying and developing expansion opportunities.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous or high\-pressure situations.
* The ability to coordinate across technical and business teams without losing momentum or accountability.
* The range to lead a C\-suite conversation in the morning and roll up your sleeves for a tactical troubleshooting session that afternoon.

### **Even Better If You Have**

* Experience working with large financial services customers.
* Familiarity with lenders, debt relief companies, major banks, credit unions, or financial marketplaces.
* Experience working with API\-driven or technically complex products.
* Experience building customer advocacy programs, including case studies, references, and executive testimonials.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

* Your enterprise portfolio maintains retention and revenue expansion goals.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager – Industrial / Loading Dock Equipment
jobs.description:
Outside Sales Representative – Loading Dock Equipment

**Extreme Dock Equipment** is a growing manufacturer of loading dock equipment based in Southern California. We manufacture **dock seals, dock shelters, and related loading dock products** and sell through distributors throughout the United States.

We are looking for an experienced **Outside Sales Representative** to build and grow our **East Coast and Midwest territory — everything east of Denver, CO.**

**Home\-based position \| Atlanta, Charlotte, or Columbus preferred \| Extensive travel**

**The more you build, the more you earn.**

A performance bonus is also available for achieving defined territory\-development and customer\-acquisition goals.

The Opportunity

This is a **territory\-building position**, not an account\-maintenance role.

You will be responsible for developing Extreme Dock Equipment's distributor network throughout the territory and creating new business.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

* Prospecting and developing new distributor accounts
* Building relationships with loading dock and material handling distributors
* Growing sales through distributor sales teams
* Identifying new market opportunities
* Calling on distributor owners, purchasing managers, sales managers, and outside salespeople
* Training distributor sales teams on Extreme Dock Equipment products
* Developing opportunities and following up on quotes
* Managing your sales pipeline
* Traveling throughout the territory to meet distributors and customers
* Attending industry trade shows and customer meetings
* Monitoring competitors and providing market feedback
* Building long\-term relationships that produce repeat business

You will have significant responsibility for **building and growing the territory**.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced B2B outside salesperson with a background in **loading dock equipment, material handling, warehouse equipment, industrial products, construction products, or a closely related industry.**

Strongly preferred experience:

* Loading dock equipment
* Dock seals and dock shelters
* Dock levelers
* Vehicle restraints
* Industrial doors
* Material handling equipment
* Warehouse equipment
* Industrial or commercial construction products
* Distributor/dealer sales

**Experience selling through distributors is strongly preferred.**

The ideal candidate understands how the loading dock and material handling industry works and has existing relationships with distributors or end users in the territory.

What We're Looking For

* 2\+ years of successful outside sales experience
* Proven ability to develop new business
* B2B sales experience
* Strong prospecting skills
* Strong relationship\-building skills
* Excellent communication and follow\-up
* Comfortable selling to business owners and decision\-makers
* Comfortable training distributor sales teams
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently
* Organized and disciplined
* Competitive and motivated by results
* Willingness to travel extensively
* Valid driver's license

Territory

**All markets east of Denver, Colorado.**

The territory includes the:

* Midwest
* Great Lakes
* Southeast
* Mid\-Atlantic
* Northeast
* Southern states

This is a **home\-based position with significant travel throughout the territory.**

**Preferred locations:** Atlanta, GA; Charlotte, NC; or Columbus, OH.

Exceptional candidates located elsewhere within the territory will also be considered.

Why Extreme Dock Equipment?

Extreme Dock Equipment is a growing manufacturer with an opportunity to significantly expand its distributor network across the United States.

This position will work directly with company leadership and will have a meaningful role in determining how the territory develops.

You won't be inheriting a mature territory and simply maintaining existing accounts.

**You'll be building it.**

We are looking for someone who wants to develop a substantial book of business and be rewarded for the results they produce.

If you're an experienced industrial salesperson who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, and winning new business, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the growth of a manufacturing company.

Apply

If you have experience selling **loading dock equipment, material handling equipment, industrial products, warehouse equipment, construction products, or related B2B products**, we'd like to hear from you.

Please submit a resume highlighting:

* Outside sales experience
* Territory responsibility
* Industries and products sold

This role owns quality KPIs, incident reporting and escalation, traceability, supplier/facility qualification, and production approval—while driving sustainability, risk management, and redundancy strategies across materials, components, and suppliers. **Key Responsibilities**

**1\) Quality Strategy, KPIs \& Governance**

* Execute and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) aligned to industry standards for Cosmetics \& OTC Personal Care Products (cGMP, ISO \& MoCRA).
* Establish and report Quality KPIs and dashboards including consumer incident rate, Vendor Scorecards, Blocking Failures and other standard metrics
* Lead quarterly Quality Business Reviews with leadership; translate trends into action plans for design, sourcing, and manufacturing partners.
* Own master standards \& reference standards management including pre\-production \& production samples, COA/COCs, functional and aesthetic standards, print and color tolerances, stability/compatibility acceptance criteria.

**2\) Incident Reporting, CAPA \& Escalation**

* Operate the consumer incident intake and triage process including coding, severity assessment, evaluation routing, and response letters.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and Corrective \& Preventive Actions (CAPA) for consumer complaints, nonconformances, and returns; ensure timely closure and effectiveness verification.
* Maintain and communicate the Quality Incident Reaction \& Escalation Matrix (e.g., safety\-related incidents, foreign matter, micro failures, packaging leakage, adverse events, mislabeling).
* Coordinate field actions (holds, retrievals, recalls) with Operations, Regulatory, and Legal as applicable.
* Provide trend analytics to drive product and process improvements upstream including scrap assessment \& ESG design collaboration.

**3\) Traceability \& Product Data Integrity**

* Ensure full product traceability from finished goods to batch/lot\-level raw materials, components, and contract manufacturers/packers.
* Maintain and audit Batch Records, Certificates of Analysis, MSDS/SDS where appropriate, and COC/COA from suppliers.
* Lead trace exercises and mock recalls; validate traceability integrity across systems (ERP/PLM/QMS).

**4\) Facility Audits \& Qualification**

* Develop and execute the Facility Audit \& Qualification program for manufacturers, fillers, testing laboratories, and key component suppliers (GMP, hygiene, allergen/contaminant controls, change control).
* Track audit findings, risk ratings, CAPAs, and requalification timelines.
* Approve pilot runs, line trials, and Process Validation where applicable; verify documentation for high\-risk categories.

**5\) Material Sourcing Strategy \& Component Specifications**

* Collaborate with Sourcing to define material sourcing strategy, quality acceptance standards, COA/COC requirements, and supplier scorecards.
* Own component spec sheets (dimensions, tolerances, resin type, PCR levels, barrier properties, sealing torque, decorative specs, ink/adhesive criteria, pump output, gasket/liner material).
* Implement material and part compatibility guidelines (formula–package compatibility, migration, stress/crack testing, thermal risk \& transit simulation).
* Manage sample review (ENG, pilot, pre\-production, and reference sets) and first article inspection (FAI) signoffs.
* Identify and escalate development projects requiring third party Packaging Engineer support

**6\) Systems, Tools \& Training**

* Administer QMS/PLM/ERP workflows for specs, NCR, CAPA, change control, and traceability.
* Lead SOP creation and training for internal teams and suppliers; certify inspectors and line operators on critical\-to\-quality attributes.
* Drive continuous improvement (Lean/Six Sigma projects) to reduce cost of poor quality and elevate consumer experience.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s in Engineering, Chemistry, Quality, or related field; advanced degree or certifications (e.g., ASQ CQE/CQA, ISO Lead Auditor, Six Sigma) preferred.
* 7–10\+ years in CPG beauty or closely related (cosmetics, personal care, OTC cosmetic\-adjacent), with hands\-on QMS leadership across suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* Demonstrated expertise in GMP for cosmetics, micro/stability/compatibility fundamentals, and packaging quality for beauty categories.
* Strong record in supplier quality, facility audits, CAPA/RCA, and production release.
* Experience implementing redundancy, risk frameworks (FMEA), and sustainability\-aligned quality standards.
* Proficiency with QMS/PLM/ERP systems; strong data and dashboard/reporting skills.
* Ability to travel as needed to CM locations during production runs, located in the Los Angeles area.

**Core Competencies**

* Systems thinking; able to connect design, sourcing, and manufacturing to consumer outcomes.
* Analytical decision\-making and statistical literacy (SPC, sampling plans, AQL).
* Clear communicator—effective with suppliers, leadership, and customer\-facing teams.
* Bias for action under ambiguity; disciplined escalation and follow\-through.
* Collaborative leadership; develops team capability and supplier partnerships.
* Detail orientation on specs/artwork with strong documentation rigor.

For this fully remote position, we would only require our candidate to come onsite to our Encinitas, CA location twice (2\) per month on a Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday. Estimated hours are Monday through Friday 8:30AM to 5:00PM with variation based on business demands.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Quality Assurance Manager to lead our testing and quality assurance initiatives across diverse software applications and platforms. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the entire QA lifecycle, ensuring that our products meet the highest standards of performance, functionality, and user satisfaction. Your expertise will drive continuous improvement in testing processes, foster collaboration with development teams, and uphold our commitment to delivering exceptional software solutions. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and possess a passion for quality, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact!

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and execution of comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automation scripts for web, mobile, and enterprise applications.
* Oversee functional, system, performance, regression, user acceptance testing (UAT), and load testing to ensure software reliability and scalability.
* Manage defect tracking processes using tools such as JIRA or HP ALM; prioritize issues and coordinate resolution efforts with development teams.
* Implement and maintain test automation frameworks utilizing tools like Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber, and scripting languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, define acceptance criteria, and ensure alignment with project goals using Agile or Waterfall methodologies.
* Conduct root cause analysis for defects or performance bottlenecks; utilize data analysis skills to identify trends and areas for improvement.
* Facilitate continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines with tools like Jenkins or GitLab to streamline release cycles and improve quality assurance efficiency.
* Perform mobile testing on Android and iOS platforms; validate APIs using RESTful services; ensure compatibility across devices and operating systems.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of test cases, test results, test scripts, and quality metrics; prepare reports for stakeholders on testing progress and quality status.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in software quality assurance within IT environments involving complex systems and multiple platforms.
* Strong background in automation testing frameworks such as Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber (BDD), along with scripting skills in Python or JavaScript.
* Hands\-on experience testing mobile applications on Android and iOS devices; familiarity with mobile testing tools is essential.
* Expertise in API testing using RESTful APIs; proficiency with tools like Postman or SoapUI is advantageous.
* Knowledge of database management systems including MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or MongoDB for data validation purposes.
* Familiarity with version control systems such as GitHub or SVN; experience integrating QA processes into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or Azure DevOps.
* Strong understanding of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), QA methodologies (functional testing, system testing, performance testing), and defect management tools.
* Excellent analytical skills for root cause analysis; ability to interpret complex data sets for process improvements.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams; adept at requirements gathering, user story creation, sprint planning, and retrospective activities.

Join us if you're passionate about elevating software quality through innovative testing strategies! Bring your expertise in automation tools, scripting languages, mobile testing platforms, API validation techniques, and collaborative mindset to help us deliver outstanding products that delight users worldwide!

Pay: $72,770\.63 \- $87,637\.74 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Parental leave

Work Location: Remote
